title: S02T05 - Add CI attestations, trust reporting, trace views, and end-to-end tests
description: Import signed or source-linked CI results, render trust levels across CLI/console/export, and prove the full witnessed closeout path including tamper, replay, and failure cases.
acceptanceCriteria: External CI and human attestations preserve issuer, subject revision, result URI, and verification status without impersonating Boreal-witnessed execution.
CLI, console, Markdown export, and trace output show evidence trust and freshness consistently.
End-to-end fixtures cover success, failure, timeout, tampering, stale commits, output truncation, and replay attempts.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
closedReason: Attestation reporting and end-to-end proof completed; serial full suite passed.
